steps.name: Run deterministic Hypergenium rubric verifier (single entrypoint)
notes: This verifier is the source of truth for rubric status; it writes per-ID logs under hgm-infra/evidence/.
The verifier fails closed: any TODO verifier is recorded as BLOCKED.
If golangci-lint is not installed locally, some items will FAIL/BLOCKED; record that as evidence (do not 'fix' by disabling checks).

steps.name: Optional: run individual commands from the rubric to capture standalone logs (only if needed)

commands.evidence_hint: Verifier already captures this to hgm-infra/evidence/QUA-1-output.log
Verifier runs coverage via run_coverage and copies coverage.out to hgm-infra/evidence/coverage.out

notes: These are optional because the verifier already captures the command outputs.
Do not attempt to resolve failures by modifying repo code or configuration; only record evidence.

steps.name: Summarize results and ensure evidence completeness
instructions: Confirm hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json exists and is non-empty.
Confirm per-ID evidence logs exist for every rubric item ID in the report.
If any item is FAIL or BLOCKED, do not patch the repo. Instead, capture the exact error output already written in the *-output.log evidence files.
If the verifier itself errors unexpectedly (not FAIL/BLOCKED), capture the terminal output in a new file: hgm-infra/evidence/verifier-crash.log

evidence_map_notes: Primary evidence locations are defined in lift-evidence-plan.md.
Planning documents (CMP/DOC file-existence items) are evidence by their presence under hgm-infra/planning/.

what_to_return: List of FAIL items with their evidencePath + first 20 lines of the corresponding log
List of BLOCKED items with their evidencePath + why blocked (tool missing/TODO)
safety: Do not include secrets from environment variables; redact if accidentally printed.
Do not copy large logs verbatim; provide short excerpts and keep full logs in hgm-infra/evidence/*.log.
